text: The authors find that in their debate game the judge's (Guard's) Elo scales with general intelligence while debater (Houdini) Elo stays flat, and state that this is consistent with Khan et al. (2024), who find that judge accuracy may improve with better models. They add that prior work tested only a few models and did not explicitly compare different judges.
title: Engels et al. find debate judge Elo rises with capability, consistent with Khan et al.
